spans.s: Viligī denotes a kind of snake in the Atharvaveda (v. 13, 7).

Viliṣṭa-bheṣaja in the Atharvaveda (Paippalāda, xx. 5, 2)
denotes a remedy for a dislocation or a sprain.

Vi-lohita is the name of a disease mentioned in the Athar-
vaveda.^1 Bloomfield^2 thinks that ‘flow of blood from the nose’
is meant; Henry^3 renders it ‘decomposition of the blood’;
and Whitney^4 has ‘anæmia.’
1) ix. 8, 1; xii. 4, 4
2) Hymns of the Atharvaveda, 657.
3) Les livres viii. et ix. de l' Atharvaveda,
105, 142.
4) Translation of the Atharvaveda
549.
